# crosswork_alarm_settings (Data Source)

This data source can read the cleanup options and the trap and syslog processing of alarms and events.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_alarm_settings" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `all_events_days` (Number) Days after which all events are deleted
- `audit_logs_days` (Number) Days after which audit logs are deleted
- `device_alarms_days` (Number) Days after which all device alarms, active and cleared, are deleted
- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `network_alarms_days` (Number) Days after which all network alarms, active and cleared, are deleted
- `non_security_device_alarms_cleared_days` (Number) Days after which cleared non-security device alarms are deleted
- `security_device_alarms_cleared_days` (Number) Days after which cleared security device alarms are deleted
- `syslog_processing` (Boolean) Process the syslog messages of the devices
- `system_alarms_days` (Number) Days after which all system alarms, active and cleared, are deleted
- `trap_processing` (Boolean) Process the traps of the devices
